thread:
Casey: Quick share — I made a tiny 2-slide micro-template pack for sprint goals + peer feedback. Pinged folks who've asked for self-review brevity tips. link: https://drive.redwood/g/snap-goal-pack :eyes:

Jamie: Sweet. Can you paste the 3-line version here so managers can copy-paste?

Casey: Sure — here's the compact template we used (3–4 lines, manager-friendly):
```
Goal (1 line): <what success looks like>
Outcome (1 line): <metric or customer impact>
Evidence (2 bullets max): - Bullet 1
- Bullet 2
Ask (optional, 1 line): <what you need from manager/peers>
```

Ari: Love the Ask entry. Can we add a single-line "Risk / blocker" as optional? helps in 1:1 prep.

Casey: Yep added. Updated snippet below (still 2 slides, one for goal + evidence, one for peer feedback + asks):
```
Goal: <one-liner>
Outcome: <metric / impact>
Evidence: - x, - y
Ask: <help needed>
Risk (opt): <one-liner>
```

Lauren: This will help calibration packets. Could you also include a 1-sentence micro-feedback prompt for peers? e.g. Observed impact / Specific example / One-sentence suggestion.

Casey: Done. Micro-feedback example: "Observed impact: shortened onboarding time by ~15% in Q1. Example: paired session on X. Suggestion: doc the runbook + 30-min handoff." — formatted as a copyable line for peers.

Michael: Small wording nit: use "Outcome" instead of "Why it matters" — clearer for ICs and PMs.

Casey: Good call, switched to Outcome across templates. Will drop a PDF and a plain text paste for folks.

peopleops-bot: Uploaded: /drive/people-ops/snap-goal-checklist-v1.pdf (perm: org) :white_check_mark:

Jamie: Nice, i'll try this in my 1:1s tomorrow and report back.

Casey: Appreciate it. If anyone wants a version with competency tags or calibration-ready snippets, tell me and I'll add a second slide. :thumbsup:
